explication: skill-up is a CLI for evaluating agent skills, agents, and workspaces. The main workflow loads and validates an evaluation, prepares a runtime and case environment, runs an agent, grades its response and workspace changes, then writes structured reports. Configuration and engine adapters support multiple built-in and custom agents; optional MCP provisioning and event logging extend runs. The bundled skill-upper plugin supports an evidence-driven improvement loop. Some branches are mapped from README claims or import references because their implementation excerpts were not provided.
